plain_text:
Stacy Harris appears in 253 recordings across 19 programs in the Golden Radio Hour archive from 1944 to 1960. The credits here include performer.

In this archive, you will hear Stacy Harris most often in This Is Your FBI, Yours Truly, Johnny Dollar, Frontier Gentleman, Escape, The Line Up, Dragnet, CBS Radio Workshop, and Gunsmoke.

Characters credited here include Jim Taylor.
